verdict.rationale: LocalAI's docs say it supports the Model Context Protocol and can connect models to external MCP servers for their tools. You select servers per request via `metadata.mcp_servers`, and you can also attach MCP servers to individual agents regardless of the model they run on. missing for 10: details on how servers are defined and which transports are supported (stdio vs. remote HTTP), and independent or hands-on confirmation that MCP tool use works as documented.
